title: Read the platform's health
description: From Home, open Platform health, read each section's one-line verdict, open a hop under where work is lost, open the outposts and the simulator's gaps, then open the server's panels on the Requests panel and follow the slowest route's figure onto its series on the server's platform component.

steps.caption: Home's Platform tile carries the platform's verdict and how many outposts are not up.
The build, its uptime and the platform's health, each read from the platform's own components. Every section below is folded to one line, its health and the one number that matters.
Open where work is lost. What is open is held in the address, so a reload keeps it.
Where work is lost follows a sample from its run to the store, hop by hop. Each hop reads a loss ratio, the share it took in and did not hand on. 0% is healthy.
Open the outpost hop to read what counts as lost there.
The keys the hop is read from, and each outpost's own share of it. The same three keys read every hop.
One row per outpost. A figure the outpost never reported reads not reported, never 0.
With a simulator connected, each gap is what the devices saw against what the platform collected, a loss ratio where 0 is healthy.
Open the server's panels. Requests ranks the slowest routes of the newest report window, highest first.
A key's name teaches it. Rest on it to read what it measures.
The figure is a series on the server's platform component, one link away.
The server's platform component, the same detail as any device. Its request timing is a series like any other metric.
